capabilities: Runs every bib block in a note as one bibdoc program
Draws live sliders, choices, buttons, cards, tables and charts
Reads front matter data and plain-YAML bib data blocks
Keeps state in memory without writing anything to the file
Matches the note's theme colours, font and text size
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.5+). No network access; the .NET runtime is bundled in main.js (about 4 MB). On Linux it runs fontconfig and reads the note's font files. State lives only while Obsidian is open and is never written to the file; the same notes also open in the bibmd desktop reader and on bibmd.app.
problem: Obsidian notes are static, so there is no built-in way to run a small program over a note's own data and see its results update live in place.
summary: Fenced-block renderer that runs small bibdoc programs over a note's data and draws live sliders, buttons, cards, tables and charts in place.
